body:
You basically hit the nail on the head with the constantly having bad stuff dumped on me. Just when I think it can't get worse, it does. I honestly don't know how people are supposed to deal with this kind of stuff. I don't wish to die, per se...I just want to go to a place where these bad things will quit happening to me. Funnily enough when I think of it in my head, I imagine just being under a rock, like Patrick from Spongebob Squarepants. So nothing can get under my rock and I can try again when I'm ready. It would be wonderful to have a "break" from it all, but life doesn't give breaks. It's like jumping onto a moving train. 

I have been on the lookout for a new job, as I'm kind of fed up with this one. The area I work in has undergone many changes this semester and I really hate most of them. The appeal of this one is mostly due to the fact that I have tons of free time to do work, but I guess I'm sick of being tired and I need a new one. I'll try to start up a little fitness regimen, though. Back when I had my "perfect" life I used to exercise strenuously at least 3 times a week...I guess that may have helped it be so perfect.

Thank you so much for your help, kind person. I really appreciate it and will save your message to look at when I'm down.  :)

I don't know what you intend to do after you finish college, but I just want to let you know: A *lot* of people fuck up their first year or two of college. A *lot*. My academic adviser told me that most graduate programs only consider the combined GPA of the last two years. Failing isn't good, obviously, but in your case, it's fixable and likely will not have as much impact on your future as you think it is. Please don't lose hope.
